svg.title: unique-10-grizzly-population
svg.desc: Historical recreation, close-up p.8 middle right; Unique; 1997-10-16. Right column clipped in scan; completed using corresponding intact Times copy. Repeated placements retained.

g.aria-label: BC has an estimated 10,000 to 13,000 grizzly bears,
which is about half of all the grizzlies in Canada, and one
quarter of all the grizzlies in North America. Over 60% of
the remaining grizzly bear habitat in Canada is
